Setting remove_navigation to false preserves nav and aside elements

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, PreprocessingOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<nav>SiteMenu</nav><main><p>MainContent</p></main><aside>SidebarText</aside>"
    options = ConversionOptions(preprocessing=PreprocessingOptions(remove_navigation=False))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
